speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the sensation of the vertigo more specifically—does the room feel like it is spinning around you, or do you feel like you are spinning while the room stays still? Also, does moving your head or changing position make the sensation worse?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

speaker: Doctor
text: The brief duration and positional trigger suggest Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). Let's confirm this by checking for nystagmus; I will perform a Dix-Hallpike maneuver on you now. Do you feel any dizziness or see your eyes jerking during this test?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Sudden-onset sensation of the room spinning. I also have Nausea, Vomiting, Dizziness.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see. Did you notice any ringing in your ears, hearing loss, or a feeling of fullness in one ear? Also, have you experienced this specific episode before, or was this truly the first time?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: The patient is otherwise healthy with only a history of eczema. No prior episodes of similar nature. Social history: No significant social history provided.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. To rule out central causes, do you have any difficulty with walking, speaking, or swallowing, or any weakness in your limbs? Also, does the vertigo return if you try to replicate the head position that triggered it?

speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text: The absence of neurological deficits and auditory symptoms strongly points away from central causes or Meniere's disease. Given the brief, positional nature of the episode, I will perform a final confirmation test. REQUEST TEST: Dix-Hallpike_Manuever
